# statusdrift_notification_channel (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift notification channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_notification_channel" "slack_alerts" {
  name    = "Slack - #alerts"
  type    = "slack"
  enabled = true

  config = {
    webhook_url = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/T00/B00/xxxx"
  }
}

resource "statusdrift_notification_channel" "email_oncall" {
  name    = "On-Call Email"
  type    = "email"
  enabled = true

  config = {
    email = "oncall@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the notification channel (max 255 characters).
- `type` (String) The type of notification channel. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `config` (Map of String, Sensitive) Configuration for the notification channel. The required keys depend on the channel type. Values are treated as sensitive.
- `emails` (List of String) Email addresses for email-type notification channels.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the notification channel is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the notification channel.
